text:
maya: Noticed oscillation during int4-v2 canary on /rerank. Opening thread for a guard.

kevin: What metrics?

maya: Variant share jumped then fell back. precision@10 down ~1.6% on RERANK_COARSE, p99 +25ms. Shadow diffs looked ok.

jess: Sounds like feedback amplification (requeries/reorders).

eval-bot: Shadow: concordance 0.987, KL(RERANK_COARSE)=0.11, reorder +5.8%.

kevin: Proposal: two-of-three autofallback requiring 3 consecutive 5m windows. Signals: quality_drop (precision@10 <= -1%), entropy_shift (mean_entropy <= -0.25 OR KL>0.08), behavior_amp (reorder_rate >= +4%).

jess: Add noise floor: effect >= 2*SE in window.

maya: Baseline: 60m rolling with decay=0.2. Rollback: immediate promote to previous stable variant; notify #eng-ml and #oncall.

kevin: Latency special-case: if p99_delta > 30ms and no quality drop -> manual escalation. If p99_delta>30ms + quality drop -> auto rollback.

infra-bot: Rollout lock will be created to avoid double-rolls.

jess: I'll run a staging sim that injects synthetic requeries.

kevin: I'll add SE-based checks and tests.

maya: PR WIP: https://git.internal/repo/rollout-policies/pull/430. If staging sim looks good we enable for int4-v2 tomorrow.

kevin: TL;DR: two-of-three autofallback, 3x5m persistence, SE noise-floor, p99 special-case.

jess: lgtm, closing after PR lands.
